[SWS_ComM_CONSTR_00002] ⌈If a ComM user reference a managed channel, then
this ComM user shall also reference the corresponding managing channel. Otherwise
the configuration is invalid. A configuration tool shall reject a configuration as invalid
(error), if a user references a managed channel without referencing the corresponding
managing channel.⌋
